We're building RiskLens Pro, an institutional portfolio risk analytics dashboard. The codebase is partially set up in the current directory. We need proper design system documentation before our frontend engineers start building out the UI components in earnest.

Please look at what's already in the codebase to understand the product, then produce a complete design system document called `DESIGN.md` in the project root. The design choices should be appropriate for our user base (professional portfolio managers and risk officers at large asset management firms) — not generic or cookie-cutter.

Also make sure the existing `CLAUDE.md` development guide is updated so future AI-assisted development sessions know to consult the design system before making any visual decisions. Don't overwrite what's already in CLAUDE.md — just add the relevant section.
